title: Tidewater design token reference
brief: I'm the design lead at Tidewater Credit Union and I need a design token reference sheet for our new member app, for the developers and designers who will keep it open on laptops beside their work. Dated 2026-10-19. Under "Colors" show each swatch with its name, hex value and role: Harbor Blue #0B5FA5 primary actions; Deep Harbor #083F70 pressed state and headers; Buoy Gold #F2A900 highlights and badges only; Mist #F7F9FB page background; Ink #1B2733 body text; Fern #1E8A4C success; Brick #C0392B errors. Under "Type scale" show each size in pixels with a sample line set at that size: caption 12, body 16, lead 20, heading 3 24, heading 2 32, heading 1 44. Under "Spacing" show the steps 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32 and 48 pixels as bars with their names space-1 to space-7. Under "In use" show three real examples built from the tokens: a primary button reading Pay now in Harbor Blue with white text, a card on Mist with Ink text and 16 pixels of padding showing the balance 2486.30 dollars, and an error message in Brick reading Card number is incomplete. Note in a highlighted callout that Buoy Gold must never be used for text on Mist, because the contrast is only about 1.9 to 1.

edit.request: Change Harbor Blue to #0A58C2 and add a color named Sky, #DCEBFA, for selected rows.
